notes.title: Star - M early access version 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Welcome players to Star-M Games and tell us what you think!

The early access version is an independent game and may contain some minor bugs. The game is initially designed as a multiplayer online, multiplayer, open, and free experience game. If you like it, you are welcome to express your thoughts, your opinions on the future design and gameplay of the game, etc. We will actively refer to the opinions of players!
